original_query: select avg(ss_quantity) ,avg(ss_ext_sales_price) ,avg(ss_ext_wholesale_cost) ,sum(ss_ext_wholesale_cost) from store_sales    ,store    ,customer_demographics    ,household_demographics    ,customer_address    ,date_dim where s_store_sk = ss_store_sk and  ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk and d_year = 2001 and((ss_hdemo_sk=hd_demo_sk and cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = 'U' and cd_education_status = 'College' and ss_sales_price between 100.00 and 150.00 and hd_dep_count = 3    )or    (ss_hdemo_sk=hd_demo_sk and cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = 'U' and cd_education_status = 'College' and ss_sales_price between 50.00 and 100.00 and hd_dep_count = 1    ) or    (ss_hdemo_sk=hd_demo_sk and cd_demo_sk = ss_cdemo_sk and cd_marital_status = 'S' and cd_education_status = 'Secondary' and ss_sales_price between 150.00 and 200.00 and hd_dep_count = 1    )) and((ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = 'United States' and ca_state in ('AR', 'OK', 'TX') and ss_net_profit between 100 and 200    ) or    (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = 'United States' and ca_state in ('KS', 'MN', 'TX') and ss_net_profit between 150 and 300    ) or    (ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk and ca_country = 'United States' and ca_state in ('KS', 'MD', 'NV') and ss_net_profit between 50 and 250    )) ;
rewritten_query:
SELECT
  AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS avg_ss_quantity,
  AVG(ss.ss_ext_sales_price) AS avg_ss_ext_sales_price,
  AVG(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost) AS avg_ss_ext_wholesale_cost,
  SUM(ss.ss_ext_wholesale_cost) AS sum_ss_ext_wholesale_cost
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN store s
  ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d
  ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
JOIN household_demographics hd
  ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
 AND hd.hd_dep_count IN (1, 3)
JOIN customer_demographics cd
  ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
 AND (
      (cd.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College')
      OR (cd.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Secondary')
     )
JOIN customer_address ca
  ON ss.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
 AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
 AND ca.ca_state IN ('AR', 'OK', 'TX', 'KS', 'MN', 'MD', 'NV')
WHERE d.d_year = 2001
  AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 200.00
  AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300
  AND (
        (cd.cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'College' AND (
             (hd.hd_dep_count = 3 AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00)
             OR (hd.hd_dep_count = 1 AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00)
        ))
        OR (cd.cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
            AND hd.hd_dep_count = 1
            AND ss.ss_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00)
      )
  AND (
        (ca.ca_state IN ('AR', 'OK', 'TX') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200)
        OR (ca.ca_state IN ('KS', 'MN', 'TX') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300)
        OR (ca.ca_state IN ('KS', 'MD', 'NV') AND ss.ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250)
      );

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Rewrite comma-style joins into explicit ANSI INNER JOINs and move all equality join predicates (ss_store_sk=s_store_sk, ss_sold_date_sk=d_date_sk, ss_hdemo_sk=hd_demo_sk, cd_demo_sk=ss_cdemo_sk, ss_addr_sk=ca_address_sk) into ON clauses. These join predicates were duplicated inside each OR branch; moving them out is equivalent because every OR branch required them.

Factor common predicates out of the OR groups: ca_country='United States' is common to all address branches and hoisted; cd_marital_status/cd_education_status pairs factored in the demographics group. Also added broad implied filters: hd.hd_dep_count IN (1,3), the union of ca_state values, cd marital/education pairs, ss_sales_price BETWEEN 50 AND 200 (union of price intervals) and ss_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 300 (union of profit intervals). These are necessary conditions of the detailed ORs and enable early filtering before the complex OR evaluation.

Avoid splitting into 9 UNION ALL branches (3 demographics x 3 address combinations): overlapping intervals and repeated large store_sales scans would add overhead. No CTE is created because there is no redundant subquery computation and the WHERE/JOIN conditions are numerous; a CTE would add materialization overhead without benefit. Consider a composite index on store_sales(ss_sold_date_sk, ss_sales_price, ss_net_profit) including ss_hdemo_sk, ss_cdemo_sk, ss_addr_sk, ss_quantity, ss_ext_sales_price, ss_ext_wholesale_cost for index-only access (score 7/10).
